headline: QA Morning Signal — 2026-09-06: Playwright adds test locks; infra and testing tools require revalidation

top_signal.title: Playwright v1.63 adds named 'lock' to serialize tests that share external resources
top_signal.summary: Playwright v1.63 (released Sep 4, 2026) introduces named test `lock` so tests that access a shared resource never run concurrently across files, workers and projects; also adds visible-only locators and richer trace snapshots.
top_signal.why_it_matters: Lets teams eliminate concurrency-driven flakiness for shared resources without serializing entire suites; simplifies safe parallelism and test scheduling.

items.title: CodeQL 2.26.4: improved language support and GitHub Actions query adjustments
items.summary: CodeQL 2.26.4 (Sep 3, 2026) adds Go 1.27 support, tighter Rust alert locations, and accuracy fixes across C#, Java/Kotlin, JS/TS and Python; GitHub Actions modeling changes may shift alert locations or counts.
items.why_it_matters: SAST rule/model changes can change alert noise and triage outcomes — QA/security teams must rebaseline scans and update triage/playbooks accordingly.

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: rootless Kubelet (KubeletInUserNamespace) promoted to Beta
items.summary: Kubernetes v1.37 (Sep 4, 2026) promotes KubeletInUserNamespace (rootless mode) to beta; kind, minikube and k3s examples and Kubernetes' own CI run node conformance on rootless clusters.
items.why_it_matters: Rootless clusters change CI/e2e test environments and host-risk assumptions — validate CNI/CSI compatibility, node labels/taints, and CI images before switching test fleets.

items.title: k6 v2.0 (current major) stabilizes TypeScript and schema changes for load testing platforms
items.summary: k6's v2.0 line (released May 11, 2026) completed API cleanup and first-class TypeScript scripting; platform authors and test authors should expect changes in test-definition formats and metric/tag conventions.
items.why_it_matters: Upgrading k6 can break test scripts and metrics ingestion; performance QA must revalidate test definitions, dashboards, and CI pipeline compatibility before upgrading.
items.source: Load testing platform analysis referencing k6 v2.0

items.title: Appium module packaging changes (mid‑2026) remove CommonJS entrypoints — update Node test harnesses
items.summary: Appium component releases in 2026 (e.g., appium-xcode 7.1.0) removed CommonJS entrypoints, requiring `import`/dynamic import() instead of `require()` in consumer code and test harnesses.
items.why_it_matters: Mobile automation suites using `require()` will break on updated Appium packages; QA teams must test and migrate Node-based runners and CI images to ESM-compatible runtimes.

watch.title: GitHub Actions: new runner deprecation REST API, GITHUB_TOKEN permission, reusable-workflow job context
watch.summary: GitHub Actions (Sep 3, 2026) added a REST API to query registration and runtime deprecation dates for runner versions, a `vulnerability-alerts` permission for GITHUB_TOKEN, and new `job` context properties for reusable workflows.
watch.why_it_matters: Monitor runner deprecation dates to schedule self-hosted runner and test-image upgrades; the new token permission supports least-privilege access for workflow-based test checks.
